name: What is the difference between standard drywall and moisture-resistant drywall?
description: Standard drywall is for dry living areas, while moisture-resistant drywall has treated facings and additives designed for humid rooms like bathrooms and laundry

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between standard drywall and moisture-resistant drywall?

acceptedAnswer.text: Standard drywall works well for dry living spaces, but moisture-prone areas like bathrooms, laundry rooms, and basements require moisture-resistant drywall, often called green board or purple board. Standard drywall features a paper backing over gypsum that deteriorates and supports mold growth when exposed to humidity or direct water contact. Moisture-resistant panels incorporate water-repellent additives and treated facers to withstand moisture. For high-splash zones like shower enclosures, cement backer board is required instead of any paper-faced drywall. Choosing the correct board prevents costly water damage and wall failures later.
acceptedAnswer.description: Standard drywall is for dry living areas, while moisture-resistant drywall has treated facings and additives designed for humid rooms like bathrooms and laundry areas.
